newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss national taken into custody on Caymans.
newsitem.headline: Swiss national taken into custody on Caymans.

text.p: Swiss national Peter Kruger was taken into custody on the Cayman Islands on Thursday in connection with an extradition order, the Swiss federal police authorities and the office of the examining judge of the Canton of Berne said.
Swiss authorities have sought Kruger's extradition since 1995, alleging he filed false bankruptcy.
Kruger and his wife Barbara won an appeal in August which allowed them to remain in the Caymans, blocking an earlier Swiss extradition order.

There is a possiblity the latest decision could be contested in a higher court as well. The highest court in this case would be the Privy Council in London, Swiss authorities said. They also said they would not seek a new extradition order for Barbara Kruger.
The authorities said the latest order was based on a European extradition agreement which took effect in the Cayman Islands on January 15, 1997.
